title: Matsurika Kanriden Manga Starts 2nd Part
content: The official X (formerly Twitter ) account of Akita Shoten 's Monthly Princess magazine announced on Wednesday that Waka Takase 's manga adaptation of Rinne Ishida and Izumi's Matsurika Kanriden (The Tale of the Scholar-Official Matsurika) light novel series is returning in the magazine's June issue on Thursday.
author: ANN

title: Yu Muraoka's Hōkago Fantasy Manga Ends
content: The "double life fantasy" manga's story centers on Hibiki Hoshino, a first year high school student at Hanagasaki High School. She decides to visit the school's manga club, and as soon as she opens the club's self-published magazine, a strong light surrounds her. The start of her adventurer life after school begins.
author: ANN

title: Cartoon Network Founder Ted Turner Dies at 87
content: Media entrepreneur Ted Turner died on Wednesday at 87 after a prolonged battle with Lewy body dementia. Turner's official website announced the news on behalf of his family. There is a private family service planned and a public memorial to come at a later date.
author: ANN

title: 16 Years Later, Acclaimed Drama Reveals Disappointing Streaming Update
content: The anime industry is growing more popular than ever across the globe, becoming one of the mainstream forms of media. Crunchyroll has established itself as the largest streaming hub for international fans. The platform adds dozens of new series to its library each quarter as part of the new seasonal lineup.
author: ComicBook

title: Yuki Ikeda's Thunder 3 Manga Ends on June 5
content: The June issue of Kodansha 's Monthly Shonen Magazine revealed on Thursday that Yuki Ikeda 's Thunder 3 manga will end in the magazine's next issue on June 5. The series entered its climax in January 2025, then went on hiatus in March that same year due to Ikeda's health.
author: ANN

title: HIDIVE Confirms Spring 2026 English Dub Release Schedule
content: The Spring 2026 anime schedule is now in full force, and HIDIVE has confirmed its English dub release plans for their anime exclusives. It’s been a great month for the streaming service so far as they have licensed some major exclusives, and have even helped to produce one of the standout hits of the Spring thus far .
author: ComicBook

title: Berserk Writer And More Honor Deceased Creator in Touching Anniversary Tribute
content: In the anime world, few creators have had as big an impact as Berserk creator Kentaro Miura. The legendary mangaka died of “aortic dissection” on May 6th, 2021, and the anime industry has never been the same.
author: ComicBook

title: N LITE Partners with Kodansha for 'Afro-Anime' Film MFINDA's Manga Adaptation
content: Entertainment news website Variety reported on Tuesday that multimedia company N LITE is partnering with Kodansha to co-develop the serialized manga adaptation of its MFINDA " AFRIME " or "afro-anime." The series will debut in Kodansha 's Biblio Sirius Magazine in 2026.
author: ANN

title: Shonen Jump Announces Sudden End of Two Major Releases
content: Shueisha has been going through some changes with the ends of some of its longer running franchises , and has announced that two of their major Jump+ releases are coming to an end very soon.
author: ComicBook
